source: make a brainrot game in 3d with cool brainrots and a index and u collect brainrots whille u run from bigger brainrots to the safe zone and place it down to collect money and add a base for people to place there brainrots

image_prompt.text: A central storefront zone where players buy upgrades between runs
An open navigable field of paths and clearings where the brainrots are found and where the bigger ones roam

layout_placement.text: Brainrot creatures scattered across the map for players to pick up and carry home
Placement pads on a player's base where a collected brainrot is set down and starts generating money
Where the bigger, hostile brainrots enter the map and the ground they patrol

notes: Survival is secondary and contributes only the hostile-origin option; its contained arena shape, which is what a chase-to-safety loop actually needs, cannot be carried because secondary genres contribute options only
The safe zone the prompt names has no option in either loaded file

open_questions.ask: What should the world around the brainrots look like - meme-bright cartoon, or something more grounded?
Is the base one per player, or one shared base everyone places into?

coverage_missing.ask: No visual theme was given at all - what does the world look like?
Does every player get their own base, or is there one shared base?
How far is it from the far end of the map to the safe zone?

answers.ask: What should the world around the brainrots look like - meme-bright cartoon, or something more grounded?
answers.answer: Use a meme-bright cartoon look to match the brainrot theme, with colorful simple 3D environments.

answers.ask: Is the base one per player, or one shared base everyone places into?
answers.answer: Give each player their own base so they can place and collect money from their own brainrots.
